goal: Decide if a new UORC archive replaces the best one so far. A smaller size must never come at the cost of lost data.

app.name: uorc-admission
app.title: Compression admission
app.purpose: Decide whether a checked candidate replaces the incumbent archive, the incumbent is kept, or the candidate is refused, from its byte-exact replay, both wire lengths and, on a tie, their byte order.

fields.name: roundtrip
fields.means: whether replay reproduces every object and boundary byte for byte

fields.name: incumbent
fields.means: the best-known archive's wire length, in bytes

fields.name: candidate
fields.means: the candidate archive's wire length, in bytes

fields.name: order
fields.means: with equal lengths, the candidate bytes against the incumbent bytes

meanings.admit: the candidate replaces the incumbent as best-known archive
meanings.refuse: the candidate is not lossless and is rejected

rules.why: src/Uorc/Search/Verify.lex.tex runTrial: any mismatch rejects the trial (full_bytes_not_digest_equality)
src/Uorc/Search/OrderRope.lex.tex beginDecision: a shorter challenger replaces the incumbent
OrderRope.lex.tex beginDecision: a longer challenger keeps the incumbent
OrderRope.lex.tex: on equal length the first differing byte decides, and a smaller byte replaces

app.otherwiseWhy: equal length and not before in byte order: keepIncumbent

properties.why: a lossy candidate is never admitted
an exact, strictly shorter archive always replaces

stakeholders.name: Compression researcher
stakeholders.text: Searches for smaller references and needs every admitted one to be exact and no longer than the one it replaces.

stakeholders.name: Benchmark reviewer
stakeholders.text: Compares measured results and needs a best-known archive never to be stated as a record or a minimum.

concerns.name: Claim boundaries
concerns.text: A best-known checked archive is not a minimality certificate or a record; record status exists only when an external authority accepts it.

components.name: UORC web client
components.text: The accessible file-oriented client in web/ and client/ that runs the search and shows the archive.

components.name: External record authority
components.text: The benchmark authority whose own rules decide whether a measured result is a record.

threats.name: Digest-only verification
threats.text: A candidate is accepted because a digest matched, while its bytes or boundaries differ.

control.name: Full byte replay
control.text: Verification compares every byte and boundary, never only a digest, and a mismatch is never admitted.

threats.name: Boundary-shifted collection
threats.text: An archive reproduces the same flattened bytes with the object boundaries moved.

control.name: Boundaries checked
control.text: Replay checks object counts and lengths, so a shifted boundary is a mismatch.

threats.name: Record claimed
threats.text: A best-known archive is published as a compression record or a minimum.
threats.accepted: The engine states only a best-known checked archive and produces no minimality certificate; README claim boundaries leave record status to the external authority.

quality.text: Every admitted archive replays its objects exactly.
quality.measureText: Requests with roundtrip differs answered admit.
